common.name: Map feed
common.description: Trains, ships, buses, road works, birds and anything else from a map feed, on Home Assistant's own map
common.select_hint: Select an item on the map to see more about it.
common.unsupported_version: uses a newer version of the map feed format. Update the card.

editor.title: Title
editor.entities_helper: Sensors that write the map feed format, drawn on the same map
editor.list: Show the items as a list
editor.list_height_helper: When the list is below the map and the card isn't held to a height. Beside the map, the list is as tall as the map.
editor.sort_helper: One of the orders the feeds offer. It can also be changed on the card.
editor.glide_helper: Moves each marker smoothly from its previous position to the new one. It then shows where the item was one update ago.
editor.frame: Frame the map when the card opens
editor.frame_helper: To the feed's area, or to what's in the feed (its area while it's empty). Leave a feed out when it shouldn't frame the map's initial view.
editor.in_list: Show this feed's items in the list
editor.in_list_helper: When off, the items are only on the map, and tapping one shows its details over the map. For a feed in the background, such as areas that never change.
editor.row_step_helper: With automatic row height, the card's height is rounded up to whole rows, or to half rows to save space.
editor.start_helper: The map opens in this view when no feed frames it. Move the preview's map to the view you want and press the button, or fill in all three fields by hand.

map_error.webgl: This browser can't draw the map, as it has no WebGL 2.
map_error.tiles: Home Assistant's map tiles aren't available. The card needs Home Assistant 2026.9 or newer.
map_error.style: The map couldn't be loaded. Check the errors in the browser's console.

gestures.windows: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
gestures.mac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
gestures.mobile: Use two fingers to move the map
